name: mentor
description: A Codex plugin for sociology literature close reading, Obsidian knowledge-base building, and paper-revision mentoring.

interface.shortDescription: Sociology literature and paper-revision mentor for Codex.
interface.longDescription: Mentor turns Codex into a sociology research assistant, Obsidian literature-system builder, full-paper close reading partner, and academic revision mentor. Version 2.0 adds a mandatory full-paper close reading mode that prevents abstract-only summaries and requires section-by-section body evidence.
defaultPrompt: Use $mentor to initialize my sociology literature system.
Use $du-wen-xian to process my paper folder.
Use $mentor to create an Obsidian-first revision workspace.
